+Root and nested `list` are mutually exclusive overloads. Root `list` requires
+`parameters` and `page` and forbids `first`; nested `list` requires a literal
+`first` from 1 through 50 and forbids the root members. The compiler rejects a
+mixed object even when it passed through a variable.
+The result keeps the outer `nodes` and `pageInfo`. Each
+`ticket.comments` is an exact readonly array and is `[]`, never `null`, when no
+authorized child is visible. A conditional selected-output Field becomes
+optional, such as `body?: string`; denial omits it rather than returning
+`null`. A nested `toOne` result remains nullable.
+The child `where` changes only the child payload, never parent membership.
+Child Policy runs before child ordering and limit, so a hidden child consumes
+no visible slot. Every child order is explicit and must end in a non-null
+primary or unique key; QUESTPIE adds no hidden tie-breaker.
+One Query may contain one inverse child list and at most four total Relation
+edges. A child list has no cursor or `pageInfo`; use an ordinary child Query for
+independent continuation. A second plural list, aggregate, quantifier,
+polymorphic Relation, or synthetic many-to-many projection remains outside
+this contract.
+The root page and child list execute as one Policy-aware PostgreSQL statement
+inside one read-only repeatable-read snapshot. A 100-row root page and 50-row
+child bound produce at most 5,050 flattened positions including the root
+sentinel. Cancellation, deadline, row-shape failure, or semantic-byte excess
+returns no partial parent or child payload, and QUESTPIE does not automatically
+retry the Query.
+Direct calls, Fetch, the generated client, and watched recomputation use the
+same linked plan and decoder. Child insert, update, delete, Relation move,
+ordering-boundary change, empty-list miss, or reached Policy-fact change dirties
+the watch. A successful recomputation replaces the complete dependency plan;
+a failed or cancelled recomputation publishes nothing.
+`QP-DATA-026 invalidInverseList` reports a wrong child source, dynamic or
+out-of-range `first`, unknown selection, non-total order, mixed overload, second
+plural list, or nested cursor at the authored Origin. `QP-DATA-022` reports a
+fifth Relation edge. Public failures contain no SQL, PostgreSQL names, Policy
+evidence, hidden cardinality, or protected values.
